approveByWitness(uint256).notice: Witness approves a will they were assigned to.

canAccess(uint256,address).notice: Returns whether `_caller` is allowed to fetch the encrypted document         (i.e., decrypt it off-chain) for a given will.

createWill(address,address,string,string.notice: Creates a new will record on-chain.

getWill(uint256).notice: Returns full will data. CID is only meaningfully usable once released,         but the struct itself is public metadata (no document contents).

rejectByWitness(uint256).notice: Witness rejects a will they were assigned to.

releaseWill(uint256).notice: Admin releases the will, granting the beneficiary access.

updateWill(uint256,string,string).notice: Updates the CID/hash of a will before witness approval (creator only).

verifyDeath(uint256).notice: Admin verifies the death/condition required for release.
